text:
anna: Heads-up — customer (AcmeMaps) reporting streaming sessions dropping mid-response and being billed as 5xx. Customer attached an app log showing ECONNRESET. They're pretty upset, asking for refund + root cause.

priya: Sorry about that. Can you paste the request_id + model + region? Also did they use our JS SDK or curl?

anna: request_id=rc-7f3a2b; model=redwood-1-large; region=us-west-2; they say this is from a mobile client using a custom websocket proxy.

miguel: quick note — gateway logs for rc-7f3a2b show an upstream OK but socket closed by peer during streaming chunk. Our billing pipeline currently marks socket-close-without-trailers as 5xx.

anna: exact app snippet from the customer's logs:```
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] INFO streaming start req=rc-7f3a2b
[2026-03-10T14:12:04Z] ERROR socket error: ECONNRESET by peer
[2026-03-10T14:12:04Z] INFO client closed connection mid-stream
```

priya: @miguel could we tell whether the FIN came from client or upstream? That affects billing classification.

miguel: server-side tcp state shows FIN from client IP 54.33.120.8 followed by our gateway sending a 502 to upstream. So it's client-initiated. We currently treat any midstream EOF as gateway error for billing.

tom: That's the problematic heuristic. Mobile proxies tend to close idle sockets (no keepalive) or reset on backgrounding. We should avoid labeling client-initiated FIN as a server 5xx.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-783 (priority P2) — Investigate streaming EOF classification. Assigned: eng-runtime.

priya: For the customer reply: propose refund for affected tokens and recommend short-term workaround: enable connection keepalive and client-side retry with resumable reads. Also ask them to send full tcpdump if they can.

anna: customer asked how we differentiate ECONNRESET vs proxy abort. They said their proxy may send RST when app backgrounded.

miguel: RST vs FIN can be detected via socket error flags and tcp trace. RST is abrupt; FIN is graceful close. In this trace we see RST followed by no upstream error payload, so it was client -> closed socket.

priya: Okay. I'll offer refund and doc steps. Draft message: "We see the client closed the socket mid-stream (ECONNRESET). Because the request didn't complete, our billing pipeline mistakenly classified this as a gateway 5xx. We'll issue a one-time credit and push a fix to avoid counting client-initiated stream aborts as customer-facing 5xx in billing." Thoughts?

tom: +1. Also recommend we add a short-term metric change: expose a 'client_aborted' tag so support can filter these from true server 5xx.

miguel: On the runtime side, plan: (1) change classifier to check socket error code and tcp close direction before marking 5xx; (2) add test harness to simulate mobile-proxy RST/FIN; (3) deploy a guard that prevents billing events for client-initiated resets for 48 hours while we validate.

priya: Can we push a hotfix to prevent refunds being blocked by automated billing rules? This customer is on enterprise and needs immediate credit.

anna: Finance confirmed we can issue manual credit. I'll include instructions in the customer reply.

sre-bot: Deploy note: canary job started for classifier patch in us-west-2. CI job: runtime/classifier#345.

miguel: Repro steps for eng-runtime: 
1) Start streaming request to redwood-1-large with slow chunk send.
2) Simulate mobile proxy by issuing TCP RST from client after first chunk.
3) Observe gateway classification and billing event.

anna: Customer-facing snippet to send: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","prompt":"...","stream":true}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams | sed -n '1,5p'
```

priya: I'll reply to customer with credit + mitigation + ask for tcpdump. Also creating a follow-up with Product about changing SLA wording for streaming edge cases.

tom: Long term: add a transparent billing classification doc for streaming (what counts as 5xx vs client abort vs network). Helps CS escalate less.

anna: Update: customer accepted the credit. They enabled keepalive as recommended and reported fewer drops in internal test. We'll leave INC-2026-783 open until classifier patch is prod.

sre-bot: INC-2026-783 status updated to investigating -> monitoring.

miguel: I'll follow up with a PR and test matrix. ETA EOD PST.

priya: Thanks all — closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
